title: Does Coverbase accept a fallback answer payload in place of extracted Wolfsberg content?
question: DEC-001 requires that answers to the fallback question set are pushed to Coverbase in place of content that would otherwise be extracted from a Wolfsberg CBDDQ. Nothing confirms Coverbase's intake accepts such a payload, or how it maps to the control set. If it does not, DEC-001 is not implementable as recorded.

origin.rationale: Surfaced while implementing DEC-001 in hop-frontend-demo. No meeting has raised it.

evidence.location: s:Requirement: Fallback answers are persisted and pushed to Coverbase
evidence.excerpt: MUST then be pushed to Coverbase in place of the content that would otherwise have been extracted from a Wolfsberg CBDDQ
